revenueHypothesis: Dealers will pay for a trusted workflow that preserves relationship context and reduces missed follow-up
mvpAcceptance: For CAR-52, requesting /campaigns settles once at /app/campaigns.

CAR-52 route tests, the full test suite, lint, and build pass for the final manifest-bearing commit.

rollback: Revert this manifest-bearing commit and restore the last verified Vercel deployment for web-cardr.
stopConditions: Stop on any target ambiguity affecting the repository, branch, commit, Vercel project, or deployment.
Stop if duplicate work is detected for the CAR-52 manifest-only governance follow-up.
Stop on any secret exposure or request to access secret values.
Stop if the delivery gate preflight fails; do not weaken the manifest or gate.
